design.metric: Parent Node performance.now immediately before writeFile(probe.css) through receipt of child IPC ACK after Playwright-verified computed style/geometry following two RAF. Includes file write, watcher, Tailwind/Vite processing, routed HTTP/WS, layout/frames, Playwright and IPC. No clock-domain subtraction.
design.cache: Fresh child Node/Vite/browser/context and unique Vite cacheDir every session. No OS filesystem cache, thermal, antivirus or machine-load reset. Two warmup edits discarded, fully retained in raw data.
design.scope: Synthetic unlayered ID rule appended to probe.css importing real src/index.css; no product writes and no new utility classes. No application JS/backend/auth. Dependency optimizer disabled in both arms. CSS dev source maps remain false.

statistics.interpretation: Four paired sessions are the replication units; 20 updates per variant are clustered within them. Descriptive pilot only, no significance or stable tail-latency claim. Lower latency in this instrumented CSS fixture does not establish app HMR or new utility generation performance.
